//: Firebase CLI configuration. Its absence is what caused
'Error: Not in a Firebase app directory (could not locate firebase.json)' —
the CLI looks for this file to know which rules belong to which service.
firebase deploy --only firestore:rules   security rules for Firestore
firebase deploy --only storage           security rules for the bucket
firebase deploy --only hosting           the built site in dist/
Firestore and Storage rules are separate deploys. Deploying one does not
touch the other, and the Storage default allows any signed-in user to write.

rewrites.//: Single-page app: every path must serve index.html so react-router can handle it. Without this, a hard refresh on /shop returns a 404 from Firebase Hosting.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so the content at a given URL never changes and can be cached indefinitely.
index.html must never be cached, or a returning visitor keeps loading the old app shell and its stale asset references.

emulators.//: Matches the ports in src/lib/firebase.ts. Set VITE_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true in .env.local to point the app here. Note the Firestore emulator needs Java installed.
